monitored_text: Resources / Blog / Top 4 Content Resources From 2023 Top 4 Content Resources From 2023 Written by Team Xometry 1 min read Published January 2, 2024 Updated November 20, 2026 To celebrate the new year, let’s take a look back at some of this year’s major content resources. To celebrate the new year, let’s take a look back at some of this year’s major content resources that will help you laugh, learn, and grow. #1: Case Study: Ryvid’s Anthem EV Bike Races Through Production Discover why this innovator in the micromobility powersport space chose Xometry to produce 50% of the parts found in its flagship electric motorcycle, the Ryvid Anthem. Read the Case Study #2: Explore Our Metal Finishes Gallery From cosmetic finishes like electropolishing to functional options such as passivation and hardcoat anodizing, we have the solutions to meet your needs. Explore and see our standard metal finish offerings; be sure to click the images to learn more about each finish. Explore the Gallery #3: [Webinar] Trimming Costs, Keeping Quality: Tips for CNC Machining Unpack actionable strategies and best practices for CNC machining by listening to this insightful webinar. Watch the Webinar #4: Video: Will It Erode? - Part 1 In this "Will it..." video, we printed the "3D Benchy" using several different materials and processes and then ran several abrasion tests on them. Watch to find out which 3D printed plastic is truly the toughest of them all. Honorable Mentions: Video: 3D Printing DC United’s Talon Meet Our Team Hypershock Chooses Xometry Video: PolyJet Full Color 3D Printing AMA with Jamison Go, Team Captain of SawBlaze, Winner of the BattleBots World Championship VII Thanks again, and Happy New Year! We look forward to unveiling even more insightful content for you in 2024.
